slots.about: the section title over the list

slots.name: next_word

slots.name: front_word
slots.about: spoken after the name of the row whose card is in front

slots.name: empty_text
slots.about: what shows when there is no card

empty.shows: empty; the stack and the list hide

fallback.shows: with one card there is no card behind and no list; with two, one card peeks

attention.shows: the front card's row gets an accent mark and name, and says front_word when spoken

labels.row: the author, and front_word on the front card's row

accessibility.reduce_motion: the phone drops rise, shrink and swap; the stack still steps on tap

notes: Source 1 technique (aceternity Card Stack), mobile and tap driven: the two cards behind peek above the front one, a tap sends the front card back (the next by id comes forward), a row brings its card to the front. No timer: the web demo cycles on an interval, a phone screen should not move on its own.
